system.description:
Once per long rest, you can instantly
extract or displace yourself and any
number of willing targets within Close
range to a place you've been before —
using a recall beacon, displacement rig,
or pre-mapped extraction point.
Make an Interface Roll (16) with the
following modifiers:
7 1- If you’re familiar with the place: +3.
2- If you visit the place frequently: +1.
3- If you’ve visited the place once: +0.
4- If you’ve only been there once: -2.
On a success, you arrive where you
were intending to go. On a failure, you
arrive off course, with the range of
failure determining how far off course.
